description: Returns the Moon's distance from Earth in kilometres and miles at a date and time, its apparent width, the previous and next perigee and apogee, and the next full Moon's distance with whether that full Moon is a supermoon.

date.description: Local calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100. Without a date and a time the result describes the Moon right now; a date alone gives 12:00 local time.

time.description: Local clock time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone name such as America/New_York or Asia/Tokyo; UTC when omitted.

name: get_moon_distance
title: Moon distance
